text:
Matt: Heads up — proposing a lightweight exporter data contract to help with PII gating + audits. TL;DR: add telemetry.pii_class (none|low|high), telemetry.pii_handle (boolean), and an audit_hook label so infra can force retention. Thoughts?

Carla: +1 for structured fields. Can we make defaults non-breaking (default to "none") and optional in SDKs? also: how big is the storage delta?

Ben: Storage delta is the key callout. If we extend TTL for high PII spans, cost jumps. Suggest tiered TTLs: high => 365d cold-tier, low => 90d standard, none => 30d. Also suggest sampling metadata kept separately to avoid duplicating full span blobs.

Rina: Security note: reversible pseudonymization requires HSM-backed KEKs and strict audit logs. For any reversible path we need envelope encryption and a recorded justification for every unmask operation. Also want per-org export allowlists for sinks.

Jess: Legal: we need the ability to preserve full traces for legal hold / incident investigations. That means an auditable, timeboxed restore mechanism. Consent flags are important (consent_granted attribute) so exports to third parties respect user consents.

Alice: From SDK/devex perspective: prefer stable, namespaced attrs to minimize collision: e.g., "telemetry.pii_class" and "telemetry.pii_handle". We'll provide helpers to set pii_class based on known attribute patterns. Backward compat: SDKs should accept missing fields as "none".

Ben: Also propose exporter gating: exporters declare a manifest of allowed pii_classes, and a global policy can block sinks that would accept high PII. That prevents accidental exfil to analytics vendors.

Matt: Example span attribute proposal:
```json
{
  "name": "http.request",
  "attributes": {
    "http.method": "POST",
    "http.path": "/v1/query",
    "telemetry.pii_class": "high",
    "telemetry.pii_handle": "true",
    "telemetry.audit_hook": "retain:365d;reason=security_investigation"
  }
}
```

devops-bot: ci/telemetry-contracts — unit tests passed on branch feature/telemetry-contracts (:white_check_mark:)

Carla: Who needs to sign off before we start gating exporters? Security + Legal + Infra?

Rina: I'll draft a spec covering key rotation, HSM usage, and unmask audit flows. Also include a recommended migration: initially mark spans, then start enforcement after 4 weeks.

Jess: Please include a table of retention obligations per region (GDPR/UK/EU vs US) and a short note on lawful access requests.

Matt: Great. I'll open a PR with the spec + migration plan and link the design doc. Owners: @Carla evaluate storage delta, @Ben prototype exporter gating, @Rina + @Jess finalize compliance text, @Alice to prepare SDK patches. Two-week review window, then canary enforcement. :thumbsup:
